definitions: The power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience.
A person or organisation having political or administrative power and control.
The power to influence others, especially because of one's recognised knowledge or expertise.
A person with extensive knowledge or expertise in a particular subject.
examples: He had the authority to make decisions.
The local authority is responsible for education.
She spoke with authority on the subject.
He is an authority on medieval history.
